svg.text: Fan-out to 7 wellness lanes | Reduce to one results set per lane | Cross-check and score in code | Synthesize to the diary wiki
Agent Graph · draft v0.1 · 2026-10-26 · for owner review
Method only: no member results in this file
G1 Plan Approval Gate — The member approves the agent roster, tests due and targets before any test runs
28 agents (5 built) · roster by age band · isolated context | solid = built or recorded · dashed = proposed
G2 Screen Review Gate — A qualified reviewer confirms any positive health screen before it is reported
3 · REDUCE — ONE RESULTS SET PER LANE
CONDITIONAL RE-TEST — old test or thin evidence
G3 Status Gate — Code sets Sterling Status; any safety flag goes to referral first
G3A Report Sign-Off — owner approves the pages
G4 Release Gate — Nothing leaves the member's local store without prior written authorization (§1.9)
DIARY WIKI -> Sterling Status · 925 Score · Fitness Assessment · Lane results with sources · Next-quarter plan · Referrals
Diamond invariant: agents never read each other's raw output — they contribute typed, cited results to a ledger; only the reducers and the cross-check layer compare across lanes.
Scoring invariant: code, never a language model, sets every score, z-score and pass or fail. The wiki is output only: it is rebuilt from the evidence and never read back as evidence.
Offline, not graph nodes: the yearly norms review, and evaluation against recorded tests.
